# Catch recovery clicks exactly at draft expiry

## What & Why
A user can activate Recover draft at the same moment its deadline passes, before the scheduled cleanup callback runs. The current guard prevents stale work from reopening, but this boundary should stay covered as expiry behavior changes.

## Done looks like
- An answer draft cannot open its edit form when recovery is activated at or after its exact deadline.
- An opportunity draft cannot open its edit form at the same boundary.
- The existing "no longer available" announcements are preserved.
